title: Sparse circular relation-token transport V2 readiness
purpose: Verify the typed LiDAR-only sparse token and dustbin transport representation on synthetic invariants and a fixed real C01-C03 batch before any V2 training.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 readiness using eight fixed fit observations, prior full-population evidence and one frozen predecessor checkpoint for compatibility only; zero training/checkpoint creation/C07-C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed continuous autonomous execution and selection of the evidence-optimal method without routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: Eight predeclared five-frame causal observations from S01 C01/C02/C03.
Sealed full-population multi-label Teacher readiness summary.
Frozen Slot seed0 checkpoint used only to verify compatible backbone keys and values.
source.prediction_run: None; readiness executes an untrained V2 model on eight fit observations.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

validation: S01-S10_C07-C08 provenance summary only; no shards or model outputs read
worlds.audit_scope: Read exactly three fit worlds and eight fixed observations; full 80-world counts are checked from an already sealed readiness summary only.

sampling.rule: Reuse the exact eight-sample batch sealed by the predecessor readiness. No sample or threshold selection is performed.

teacher.source: Objective event, geometry and branch identity from TNG/spline/mesh-derived dataset fields.
teacher.valid_mask: All eight rows have complete five-observation histories. At most six unique branch identities per frame; -1 remains absent.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Identity aligns sparse tokens only inside readiness loss construction. Forward receives scans only. No graph node, edge or planner action is produced.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only fit rows are used for finite-forward/backward and invariants. The C07-selected predecessor checkpoint is read solely for key/shape/value compatibility and cannot select V2 outputs or thresholds.

methods.main: A 783675-parameter five-frame circular network emits six soft-localized exit tokens per frame and explicit previous-token to current-token-or-dustbin rows plus current reveal logits. Verify typed input, checkpoint compatibility, relation semantics, rotation, permutation, reverse time, determinism, finite outputs and complete gradients.
methods.baseline: Failed 819067-parameter dense relation V1 with last-frame axis and independent balanced BCE.
methods.fallback: If transport semantics, equivariance, checkpoint compatibility or real gradients fail, stop before training and repair only the failed interface; do not substitute the dense field or enter graph.

failure_policy: No optimizer step, checkpoint creation, C07/C08 shard read, strict-test read, threshold tuning, graph or planner. Any source, row, count, token uniqueness, finite-gradient or invariance failure stops the run.
retention: Retain full-population provenance, real-batch manifest, synthetic semantic checks, compatibility report, figures/source, environment, log, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: One deterministic CUDA forward/backward on eight fit observations plus CPU audits
